HASTA LA VICTORIA SIEMPRE! 

LOOK: Members of the Philippines-Cuba Cultural Friendship Association gather to protest along Elliptical Road in Quezon City on Saturday, March 21, to express their opposition to United States President Donald Trump’s recent statement claiming he would have “the honor of taking Cuba” soon.

The United States is looking for President Miguel Diaz-Canel to step down as part of ongoing talks with Havana, a move seen as an effort to avert potential U.S. military intervention. | 📷: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer
